---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

hr_by_season <- Teams |> 
  group_by(yearID) |> 
  summarize(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    hr_per_game = total_HR / total_games
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    season_type = if_else(
      yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
      "Shortened",
      "Regular"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type)) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Runs per Game by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Game",
    color = "Season Type",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```

```{r}
Teams |> 
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |> 
  group_by(yearID) |> 
  summarize(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    hr_per_game = round(total_HR / total_games, 2)
  ) |> 
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Season", "Total Home Runs", "Total Team-Games", "Home Runs / Game")
  )
```
